source_claims.quote: Odin (Old Norse: Óðinn) is the main god in Norse mythology. Described as an immensely wise, one-eyed old man

statement.id: Odin adalah dewa utama mitologi Nordik yang digambarkan bijak dan bermata satu.
statement.en: Odin is a leading Norse god depicted as wise and one-eyed.

source_claims.quote: Odin can be recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye

statement.id: Odin dikenali dari topi dan jubahnya, janggut panjang, dan hanya satu mata.
statement.en: Odin is recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye.

source_claims.quote: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes

statement.id: Tombak Gungnir adalah salah satu atribut utama Odin.
statement.en: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes.

source_claims.quote: Odin's connection with war flows naturally into a connection with the dead, which is further illustrated by Odin as the leader of the so-called Wild Hunt - a widespread and old Germanic cult centred around a myth of an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

statement.id: Hubungan Odin dengan perang berlanjut ke hubungannya dengan orang mati, antara lain sebagai pemimpin Perburuan Liar (Wild Hunt), pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai.
statement.en: Odin's link with war extends to a link with the dead, shown in his role as leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
